name: Bradbury Building
style: Renaissance Revival architecture; Mediterranean Revival architecture
heritage: National Historic Landmark; Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument; National Register of Historic Places listed place
text: The Bradbury Building is an architectural landmark in downtown Los Angeles, California, United States. Built in 1893, the five-story office building is best known for its extraordinary skylit atrium of access walkways, stairs and elevators, and their ornate ironwork. The building was commissioned by Los Angeles gold-mining millionaire Lewis L.

depictions.name: Bradbury Building
depictions.text: The is a landmark featured in L.A. Noire. It is located at the corner of 3rd St. and Broadway in the Central District.
